## 19.1 Package Architecture for Geocode.jl

Geocode.jl must solve three engineering challenges: abstracting over multiple geocoding service APIs (Census, Nominatim, Google), implementing robust rate limiting and retry logic, and handling the messy reality of address data quality (incomplete addresses, abbreviations, P.O. boxes, rural route designations). The design uses a trait-based service abstraction so users can switch backends without changing call sites.

```julia
# === src/Geocode.jl: Module architecture ===

module Geocode

using HTTP, JSON, CSV, DataFrames, URIs

# ── Abstract service type ─────────────────────────────────────
"""
    AbstractGeocoder

Abstract supertype for all geocoding backends.
Subtypes must implement:
  - geocode(::AbstractGeocoder, address::String) → GeocodedAddress
  - geocode_batch(::AbstractGeocoder, addrs::DataFrame) → DataFrame
"""
abstract type AbstractGeocoder end

# ── Result type ───────────────────────────────────────────────
"""
    GeocodedAddress

Standardized geocoding result across all backends.
"""
struct GeocodedAddress
    input_address    :: String
    matched_address  :: Union{String, Missing}
    lat              :: Union{Float64, Missing}
    lon              :: Union{Float64, Missing}
    match_type       :: Symbol   # :exact, :non_exact, :tie, :no_match
    quality          :: Float64  # 0.0 (no match) to 1.0 (exact)
    census_tract_fips :: Union{String, Missing}  # US-specific
    source           :: Symbol   # :census, :nominatim, :google, etc.
end

# ── Concrete geocoder types ───────────────────────────────────
"""Census Bureau Geocoder (free, U.S. addresses only)"""",
struct CensusGeocoder <: AbstractGeocoder
    benchmark    :: String
    vintage      :: String
    timeout      :: Int
    max_retries  :: Int
    CensusGeocoder(; benchmark="Public_AR_Current",
                     vintage="Current",
                     timeout=30,
                     max_retries=3) =
        new(benchmark, vintage, timeout, max_retries)
end

"""OpenStreetMap Nominatim (free, global, rate limited to 1 req/sec)"""",
struct NominatimGeocoder <: AbstractGeocoder
    base_url     :: String
    user_agent   :: String  # Required by Nominatim usage policy
    timeout      :: Int
    NominatimGeocoder(user_agent::String;
                       base_url="https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org",
                       timeout=10) =
        new(base_url, user_agent, timeout)
end

# ── Exports ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
export AbstractGeocoder, GeocodedAddress
export CensusGeocoder, NominatimGeocoder
export geocode, geocode_batch, geocode_all
export normalize_address, score_match

include("census.jl")
include("nominatim.jl")
include("batch.jl")
include("normalize.jl")

end  # module Geocode
```


### 19.1.1 Census Geocoder Backend — Full Implementation

```julia
# === src/census.jl ===
# Census Bureau Geocoder: batch endpoint, free, no API key

using HTTP, CSV, DataFrames, Dates

"""
    geocode_batch(g::CensusGeocoder, addresses::DataFrame)

Batch geocode up to 1,000 U.S. addresses via Census Geocoder API.
addresses must have columns: :id, :street, :city, :state, :zip
Returns DataFrame with original columns plus geocoding results.
"""
function geocode_batch(
        g::CensusGeocoder,
        addresses::DataFrame
    )::DataFrame

    nrow(addresses) <= 1000 ||
        error("Batch limit is 1,000. Use geocode_all() for larger datasets.")

    _required_cols = [:id, :street, :city, :state, :zip]
    for col in _required_cols
        col in propertynames(addresses) ||
            throw(ArgumentError("Missing required column: $(col)"))
    end

    # ── Build CSV payload ─────────────────────────────────────
    buf = IOBuffer()
    for row in eachrow(addresses)
        line = join([string(row.id), string(row.street),
                     string(row.city),  string(row.state),
                     string(row.zip)], ",")
        println(buf, line)
    end
    payload = take!(buf)

    # ── POST to Census Geocoder ───────────────────────────────
    url = "https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/geographies/addressbatch"
    resp = _retry(g.max_retries, g.timeout) do
        HTTP.post(url, [],
            HTTP.Form([
                "addressFile" => HTTP.Multipart("addr.csv",
                                    IOBuffer(payload), "text/csv"),
                "benchmark"   => g.benchmark,
                "vintage"     => g.vintage,
                "format"      => "json"
            ])
        )
    end

    # ── Parse response ────────────────────────────────────────
    _parse_census_response(resp, addresses)
end

function _parse_census_response(resp, original::DataFrame)::DataFrame
    body = String(resp.body)
    # Census returns CSV with variable column count
    # Matched: id,input_addr,Match,Exact,matched_addr,lonlat,TIGERID,side,state,county,tract,block
    # Unmatched: id,input_addr,No_Match
    result_rows = []
    for line in eachline(IOBuffer(body))
        isempty(strip(line)) && continue
        parts = split(line, ","; limit=12)
        id  = string(parts[1])
        matched = length(parts) >= 3 && parts[3] == "Match"
        if matched
            exact   = parts[4] == "Exact"
            matched_addr = length(parts) >= 5 ? parts[5] : missing
            lonlat  = length(parts) >= 6 ? split(parts[6], ",") : nothing
            lon = !isnothing(lonlat) && length(lonlat)==2 ?
                      tryparse(Float64, lonlat[1]) : missing
            lat = !isnothing(lonlat) && length(lonlat)==2 ?
                      tryparse(Float64, lonlat[2]) : missing
            sf  = length(parts) >= 9  ? rpad(parts[9],2,'0')  : missing
            sc  = length(parts) >= 10 ? rpad(parts[10],3,'0') : missing
            st  = length(parts) >= 11 ? lpad(parts[11],6,'0') : missing
            fips = (!ismissing(sf) && !ismissing(sc) && !ismissing(st)) ?
                       sf*sc*st : missing
            push!(result_rows, (id=id, lat=lat, lon=lon,
                matched_address=matched_addr,
                match_type=exact ? :exact : :non_exact,
                quality=exact ? 1.0 : 0.75,
                tract_fips=fips, source=:census))
        else
            push!(result_rows, (id=id, lat=missing, lon=missing,
                matched_address=missing, match_type=:no_match,
                quality=0.0, tract_fips=missing, source=:census))
        end
    end
    return DataFrame(result_rows)
end

# ── Exponential backoff retry wrapper ─────────────────────────
function _retry(f::Function, max_retries::Int, timeout::Int)
    for attempt in 1:max_retries
        try
            return f()
        catch e
            if attempt == max_retries || !(e isa HTTP.ExceptionRequest.StatusError)
                rethrow(e)
            end
            sleep_time = 2.0^(attempt - 1)  # 1, 2, 4 seconds
            @warn "Geocoder attempt $(attempt) failed: $(e). Retrying in $(sleep_time)s"
            sleep(sleep_time)
        end
    end
end
```


### 19.1.2 Chunked Batch Geocoding for Large Address Files

```julia
# === src/batch.jl ===
# Handles arbitrarily large address files via chunking

"""
    geocode_all(g::AbstractGeocoder, addresses::DataFrame;
                batch_size=500, sleep_sec=1.0, verbose=true)
```

Geocode an arbitrarily large address list by splitting into batches.

Respects rate limits with configurable sleep between batches.

Writes progress to stdout if verbose=true.

Returns combined DataFrame of all geocoded results.

"""

```julia
function geocode_all(
        g::AbstractGeocoder,
        addresses::DataFrame;
        batch_size::Int = 500,
        sleep_sec::Float64 = 1.0,
        verbose::Bool = true
    )::DataFrame

    n = nrow(addresses)
    n == 0 && return DataFrame()

    # Validate and coerce column types
    addresses = _prepare_addresses(addresses)

    # Create batches
    n_batches = ceil(Int, n / batch_size)
    batches = [addresses[((k-1)*batch_size+1):min(k*batch_size, n), :]
               for k in 1:n_batches]

    results = Vector{DataFrame}(undef, n_batches)
    t_start = time()

    for (k, batch) in enumerate(batches)
        verbose && print("Batch $(k)/$(n_batches) ($(nrow(batch)) records)...")
        t0 = time()
        results[k] = geocode_batch(g, batch)
        elapsed = round(time() - t0; digits=1)
        matched = count(r -> r.match_type != :no_match, eachrow(results[k]))
        verbose && println(" $(matched)/$(nrow(batch)) matched ($(elapsed)s)")

        # Rate limit compliance
        if k < n_batches
            sleep(sleep_sec)
        end
    end

    combined = vcat(results...)
    total_elapsed = round(time() - t_start; digits=1)
    total_matched = count(r -> r.match_type != :no_match, eachrow(combined))

    verbose && println("")
    verbose && println("Total: $(total_matched)/$(n) matched ($(total_elapsed)s total)")

    return combined
end

# ── Address normalization for better match rates ──────────────
"""Normalize common address abbreviations before geocoding"""
function normalize_address(addr::String)::String
    addr = strip(addr)
    addr = replace(addr, r"\bST\b"i  => "STREET")
    addr = replace(addr, r"\bAVE\b"i => "AVENUE")
    addr = replace(addr, r"\bDR\b"i  => "DRIVE")
    addr = replace(addr, r"\bRD\b"i  => "ROAD")
    addr = replace(addr, r"\bBLVD\b"i=> "BOULEVARD")
    addr = replace(addr, r"\bLN\b"i  => "LANE")
    addr = replace(addr, r"\bPKWY\b"i=> "PARKWAY")
    # Remove apartment numbers (often confuse geocoders)
    addr = replace(addr, r"\s+(APT|UNIT|STE|#)\s+\S+"i => "")
    return uppercase(addr)
end
```
